title: rt=msg.custody CoRE discovery
description: Custody-capable nodes MUST advertise rt=msg.custody in /.well-known/core responses. Only nodes with non-volatile storage that can persist custody messages across reboots should advertise. Battery leaf nodes MUST NOT advertise. Spec: 05-routing.md §9.8.1, 12-apps.md §18.1.4. All three impls.
